# SlideShowPlayer

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

**Play** a presentation as a slide show: letterboxed on black, hidden slides left out, each slide's transition (fade, push, wipe, split, cover, zoom) and timing, a slide by number, black / white screen, an end screen ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer.md))

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer> CreateSlideShowPlayer(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetClock()` | `void SetClock(std::function<double()> clock)` | The clock the transitions and timings run by, in seconds; the default reads std::chrono::steady_clock. A test replaces it and calls Tick. |
| `onShowEnd` | `std::function<void()> onShowEnd` | Escape, or on from the end screen |
| `onSlideChanged` | `std::function<void(int slide)> onSlideChanged` | the slide shown changed; -1: the end screen |
| `AddObserver()` | `int AddObserver(std::function<void()> changed)` | For a view that follows the player (UltraCanvasPresenterView): `changed` runs after any change - the slide, a transition ending, the show starting or ending, a blank screen. Returns an id for RemoveObserver. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Other methods

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Start` | `void Start(int fromSlide = 0)` | From `fromSlide` (0-based; the first slide shown at or after it), without a transition, and takes the keyboard. |
| `Stop` | `void Stop()` | Ends the show: onShowEnd. |
| `GoToSlide` | `void GoToSlide(int index)` | Slide `index` (0-based, a hidden one too) at once, without a transition. |
| `Next` | `void Next()` | The next slide shown, with its transition; after the last the end screen, and from the end screen the show ends. |
| `Previous` | `void Previous()` | The slide shown before this one, without a transition; from the end screen the last slide. |
| `Tick` | `void Tick()` | Brings the show to the clock's time: ends a transition that is over, moves on from a slide whose time is up. The player's timer calls it (about 60 times a second during a transition, once when a slide's time is up, not at all otherwise). |
| `Render` | `void Render(IRenderContext* ctx, const Rect2Df& dirtyRect) override` |  |
| `OnEvent` | `bool OnEvent(const UCEvent& event) override` |  |
| `AcceptsFocus` | `bool AcceptsFocus() const override` |  |
| `SlideArea` | `Rect2Dd SlideArea() const` | Where the slide is drawn, in the element's coordinates (letterboxed). |

### struct `SlideShowWindows`

The windows of a show StartSlideShow opened. Keep it until onEnd: the windows close when the show ends (Escape, on from the end screen, or a window closed), and then onEnd runs.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `showWindow` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWindow> showWindow` |  |
| `player` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlideShowPlayer> player` |  |
| `presenterWindow` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWindow> presenterWindow` | On the first monitor when there are two; null otherwise. |
| `presenter` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPresenterView> presenter` |  |
| `onEnd` | `std::function<void()> onEnd` |  |
